data.description:
## Description

**What**: fetcher.py running JQL `project = DIG AND (resolution = Unresolved OR updated >= -1h)` with startAt pagination. Silent-truncation detector at 1000-issue hard ceiling. Per-issue mutation dedup in differ.
**Why**: Pagination + truncation handling is the load-bearing correctness step the orchestrator needs before running against live working set.
**Scope**:
- IN: fetcher.py, startAt pagination per-page, SilentTruncationError, mid-fetch-update test against throwaway DIG issue
- OUT: JQL filter optimization, dependent-key-shard pagination (future)

## Done Definitions

- Against a recorded fetcher fixture with 1500 issues spread across pages of 100, the fetcher returns all issues exactly once and the differ produces a stable, deduplicated mutation list ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When the working set reaches the 1000 hard ceiling, the fetcher raises SilentTruncationError and the orchestrator aborts the pass before emitting any mutations ← Satisfies: sc-3
- An integration test against a throwaway DIG issue inserts a marker update immediately after pass-start; the differ emits exactly one mutation for the affected issue and the marker-update is picked up on the next pass ← Satisfies: sc-3
- Per-issue mutation dedup is enforced: an issue appearing on two pages mid-fetch yields exactly one mutation tuple in the canonical manifest ← Satisfies: sc-2, sc-3
- Unit tests written and passing for all new logic ← Validates Closure Check: "TDD DoD"

## Considerations

- [Reliability] The mid-fetch-update test must use a throwaway DIG issue; running it against production tickets risks emitting a real mutation.
- [Performance] startAt pagination is per-page; do not cache pages across passes — stateless convergence forbids it.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a reconciler operator, I want the fetcher to page through Jira with startAt and detect silent truncation
